study: Claim-specific witness distinguishing power and limits for pinned tau2 Airline Task 8

claims.C1_RESERVATION: Exactly one new reservation for the intended user, linked to their reservation list, with pre-existing reservation IDs preserved
claims.C2_BOOKING_FIELDS: C1 and source-derived route, one-way, economy, flight, date, two expected synthetic passengers, payment history, zero baggage, no insurance
claims.C3_COMMIT_CONSISTENCY: C2 and source-local economy inventory decrement, fare consistency, certificate existence beforehand and consumption afterward
claims.C4_PROCESS_AUTH_ROOT: Appropriate authorization, actual principal, independently administered native effect source and correct process; not testable by source-local state alone

construct_boundaries: Native evaluator DB hash equality is not process assurance
State projection is not semantically independent from authoritative tau2 model
Asha of bytes is not an independent assertion of truth
Q1C GitHub Issue is not construct-equivalent to Airline DB
Native Task8 reference actions are a target-DB construction aid, not required per-action policy
Passenger digests refer only to a published synthetic dataset; not safe anonymization for real persons
No model, no user interaction and no COMMUNICATE evaluation

development_controls.withheld_field_test: delete edited field in both worlds and compare canonical projections bytewise
development_controls.interpretation: pairwise indistinguishability conditional on fixed projection, not globally minimal witness
